title: Gemini app tasks mode works while users are away, for $19.99 and up
source_used: PPC Land (read in full); it reports and analyses Google's own blog post of 13 Oct 2026
key_facts: Google made Gemini 4 Argon, its newest reasoning model, available in the Gemini app on 13 Oct 2026 for Google AI Pro and Ultra subscribers only (PPC Land, from Google's blog post).
The post adds a toggle from chat to "tasks" that Google says lets Gemini "work for you even when you're not at your computer" across Google apps and more.
Google says Gemini now connects to "more than 40 apps", naming Instacart, OpenTable, Adobe and Shopify; PPC Land notes a help page already listed 41 apps in August, so the figures do not reconcile.
Google Antigravity's agentic coding interface is now available in the Gemini macOS app.

The post gives no benchmarks, usage limits, country list or prices, and says nothing on free or AI Plus users; PPC Land cites earlier Google documentation of AI Pro at $19.99 a month and Ultra at $99.99 or $199.99.
Google describes Argon as answering "more directly with less hedging" and skipping clichés, claims PPC Land says come without measurement.
PPC Land asks whether the tasks toggle is the earlier Gemini Spark background agent; Google's post does not say.
quote_evidence: Google put its newest AI model, Gemini 4 Argon, into the Gemini chatbot app today, but only for people who pay for the AI Pro or Ultra plans.
None of those claims comes with a measurement.
Is the new toggle Spark under another label, a redesigned entry point to it, or something separate?
why_it_matters_hint: Google is keeping its newest model and its background task agent for paying tiers while adding more shopping and booking connections.
notes: Full text read. PPC Land is an advertising-industry outlet; its text states that Google's post is the only official text. Google's claims of quality are unmeasured. The Gemini 4 Argon model release itself is covered in category 01 (C01-01).
